submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 4mm plate thickness provides the best energy resolution of 2.953% at 100 GeV among all tested configurations. This represents approximately 25% improvement over Absorber-F1's best performance (3.977% at 6mm) and 42% improvement over Absorber-F2 (~5.9% at 2mm). The material meets all safety constraints with dose rates below 20 μSv/h after one week of cooldown, enabling hands-on maintenance. The 4mm thickness falls comfortably within the 2-10mm operational range and represents the optimal balance for this material, as confirmed by systematic thickness scans showing degraded performance at both thinner (3mm: 3.309%) and thicker (4.5mm: 3.046%, 5mm: 3.274%) plates.
